propositions: A single criterion's LLMBudgetExhaustedError or RunawayToolLoopError during evidence gathering aborts the entire recovery and prevents the finalizer from running with partial evidence
Token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError from an evidence run is not distinguished from non-token errors, causing premature failure of the recovery when token limits are hit
Per-criterion budget exhaustion is treated as fatal to aggregate recovery rather than as a per-criterion safeguard, discarding all gathered evidence
Recovery must catch budget and runaway errors per criterion, emit content-free placeholder evidence entries, and continue to the finalizer so partial evidence can be scored
If all criteria exhaust their budgets, recovery fails with CompletionRecoveryError carrying counts; if only some exhaust, recovery continues with placeholders and produces a verdict
